structured.answer: I'd rather see option א, "עמודה לכל דרך": one bar for the fund and one for the other account, with the big total underneath (66,513 ₪ against 19,595 ₪). I can read the parts down the side one at a time, and "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן" tells me what it means.

stuck.where: Option א, the pink '−13,974 ₪ מס במשיכה' at the top of the fund bar
stuck.why: A minus in red/pink made me back off; it took a while before I connected it to 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' and saw it is gone at 6 years
The bars float at different heights and run left to right, so reading from the right I hit the total first and the steps backwards
English letters S&P500 and 'קרן מחקה' made me feel it was not for me; I only kept the 12,000 ₪ salary
